  "evidence": "The failing test not_null_fct_orders_region_name indicated many null region_name values in fct_orders (14744 of 15000 rows). These nulls come from the left join to dim_customers, which was missing region_name for most customers. Examining dim_customers.sql showed incorrect join conditions: it joined stg_customers to stg_nations on customer_key = nation_key and used an inner join to stg_regions, causing most customers to be dropped. Correcting the joins to use c.nation_key = n.nation_key and making the join to stg_regions a left join restores the full set of customers and their region names. A try_patch with the corrected SQL passes all checks."
